mapper.insert: INSERT INTO student (name, student_no, gender, phone, class_id, enrollment_date) VALUES (#{name}, #{studentNo}, #{gender}, #{phone}, #{classId}, #{enrollmentDate})
mapper.select: SELECT s.id, s.name, s.student_no, s.gender, s.phone, s.class_id, c.class_name, s.enrollment_date, s.create_time, s.update_time, s.is_deleted FROM student s LEFT JOIN `class` c ON s.class_id = c.id AND c.is_deleted = 0 WHERE s.id = #{id} AND s.is_deleted = 0

SELECT s.id, s.name, s.student_no, s.gender, s.phone, s.class_id, c.class_name, s.enrollment_date, s.create_time, s.update_time, s.is_deleted FROM student s LEFT JOIN `class` c ON s.class_id = c.id AND c.is_deleted = 0 WHERE s.student_no = #{studentNo} AND s.is_deleted = 0 LIMIT 1
mapper.update: UPDATE student SET name = #{name}, student_no = #{studentNo}, gender = #{gender}, phone = #{phone}, class_id = #{classId}, enrollment_date = #{enrollmentDate} WHERE id = #{id} AND is_deleted = 0
